name: Tiling
description: Partition loop nests into rectangular tiles to fit intermediate results in cache (L1/L2), improving data reuse and compute intensity. Tile sizes are specified as a list of positive integers or zeros; zero means no tiling for that dimension.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: List of tile sizes (one per loop dimension). A size of 0 means no tiling for that dimension. All-zero lists are invalid (no-op). Example: [32, 32, 32] for 3D tiling.
